finding: SecureBio found a gap in Anthropic's biological-weapons classifier constitution: at least one topic close to novel bioweapons production is missing, and half of the BioTIER prompts Opus 4.6 failed to refuse fell into precisely that missing topic.
finding_quote: Half of un-refused queries fell into the one aforementioned topic missing from the constitution; the others were scattered across five Catastrophe Avoidance and two Biomedical DURC (dual-use research of concern) topics.
tier_reasoning: Gate 1 yes — measured refusal failures traced to a specific safeguard gap. Gate 2: (a) empirical, (b) names Anthropic and Opus 4.6, (c) concerning — an identified uncovered CB topic in a production safeguard, and SecureBio's first recommendation is that Anthropic add it.
